P03.2: the deterministic, explainable half of entity resolution

Deterministic ER on top of the P03.1 identity substrate (14.2/14.4/14.6/14.8):

- normalize_org_name(): pure, versioned name normaliser with a committed
  test-vector suite in CI; Sheriff Office/Department collapse to one suffix;
  acronyms resolve by exact lookup only, never fuzzy (SIG-IDENT-022).
- ORI validated by pattern ^[A-Z0-9]{9}$ (never positional); UCR<->USPS table
  incl NB->NE, GM->GU; civil/applicant-ORI flag (SIG-IDENT-002/003).
- Per-class canonical scheme registry + the Wikidata-not-for-US-LE asymmetry
  (SIG-IDENT-001/007).
- Deterministic cascade tiers 0-3, all auto-write, each recording match_tier +
  match_evidence; a civil ORI is refused as a sole basis; Tier-2 gated by a
  data-generated collision list; tiered address keys with K3/K4 blocking-only;
  vendor-portal slug parsing as a versioned-grammar hypothesis
  (SIG-IDENT-020/025/013/015).
- Public sig:<type>:<uuidv7> minting, dereferenceable with content negotiation,
  and the stability contract: split/merge are dated events with
  redirects_to/split_into pointers and tombstones; no id silently reassigned
  (SIG-IDENT-031/032).
- SIG<->external and ORI9->GEOID crosswalk exports behind the policy licence
  gate (SIG-IDENT-033/034).

Rulesets are versioned data (resolution/src/resolution/data/*.toml), not code.
Traceability matrix and risk register updated; tiers 4-5 / gold-holdout /
cluster-shape alerts / auto-demotion are handed to P05.1.
